children.text: Unit Learning Goals
Introduction & Target Outcomes
In this unit, we will learn to use words and expressions about places and travel.
children.cn: 在本单元中，我们将学习使用有关地点和旅行的词汇与表达。
children.notes: learn to do sth. = 学习做某事；words and expressions = 词汇与表达。
children.statement: learn to 后面通常接动词原形。
children.explanation: learn to do sth. 表示“学习做某事”，后接动词原形。

children.text: We will share travel stories and talk about cultural differences.
children.cn: 我们将分享旅行故事，并谈论文化差异。
children.notes: share = 分享；cultural differences = 文化差异。
children.statement: cultural 是名词形式，意思是“文化”。
children.explanation: cultural 是形容词，意为“文化的”；名词形式是 culture。

children.text: Look and Say Activity
Country Identification
Which countries do the things come from?
children.cn: 这些物品来自哪些国家？
children.notes: come from = 来自……，属于常用动词短语。
children.statement: come from 与 be from 意义相同。
children.explanation: come from 和 be from 都表示“来自哪里”。

children.text: The countries include the UK, France, Italy, Canada and Australia.
children.cn: 这些国家包括英国、法国、意大利、加拿大和澳大利亚。
children.notes: the UK 前面通常要加定冠词 the。
children.statement: UK 前面通常不需要加定冠词 the。
children.explanation: UK 是缩写国家名，由联合王国组成，前面需要加定冠词 the。

children.text: Email Greeting & London Tour
Greeting and London Eye
Hi Lingling!
children.speaker: Daming
children.notes: 英语书信/邮件常用的非正式问候语。
children.statement: 这是一种用于朋友间日常邮件的非正式问候方式。
children.explanation: Hi 属于非正式的友好招呼用语。

children.text: How are you now?
children.speaker: Daming
children.notes: 询问对方当前身体或生活状况的常用句型。
children.statement: 这是一个用于关心对方情况的特殊疑问句。
children.explanation: How 开头的特殊疑问句，用于询问身体或近况。

children.text: We are all worried about your leg.
children.speaker: Daming
children.notes: be worried about = 为……担心。
children.statement: worried 后面常接介词 at 来表示担心。
children.explanation: be worried 习惯接介词 about，意为“为……感到担忧”。

children.text: Sam and Amy took us around London.
children.speaker: Daming
children.cn: 萨姆和埃米带我们游览了伦敦。
children.notes: take sb. around = 带某人游览、四处参观；took 是 take 的过去式。
children.statement: took 是动词 take 的过去式。
children.explanation: take 的一般过去式是不规则变化 took。

children.text: Sightseeing Highlights
What a wonderful city it is!
children.speaker: Daming
children.cn: 这是一座多么精彩的城市啊！
children.notes: 感叹句结构：What + a/an + 形容词 + 可数名词单数 + 主语 + 谓语！
children.statement: 这是一个由 What 引导的感叹句。
children.explanation: What a/an + adj. + n. + 主 + 谓！是标准的感叹句型。

children.text: We had a good view from the London Eye.
children.speaker: Daming
children.cn: 从伦敦眼上我们看出去视野特别好。
children.notes: have a good view = 视野好、饱览美景；the London Eye = 伦敦眼摩天轮。
children.statement: view 在此处表示“视野、风景”。
children.explanation: view 在本句中作名词，意为“视野；风景”。

children.text: We saw Big Ben, Buckingham Palace and Tower Bridge.
children.speaker: Daming
children.cn: 我们看到了大本钟、白金汉宫和塔桥。
children.notes: saw 是 see 的过去式；Big Ben 大本钟；Buckingham Palace 白金汉宫；Tower Bridge 伦敦塔桥。
children.statement: saw 是动词 see 的原形。
children.explanation: saw 是 see 的过去式，原形是 see。
children.keywords: saw, Big Ben, Buckingham Palace, Tower Bridge

children.text: Tower Bridge & Photo Surprise
Walking on the Glass Floor
Do you remember the song "London Bridge is falling down"?
children.speaker: Daming
children.cn: 你还记得那首《伦敦桥要倒塌了》的歌吗？
children.notes: remember = 记得；falling down = 倒塌。
children.statement: remember 意为“忘记”。
children.explanation: remember 意为“记得”，其反义词是 forget（忘记）。

children.text: There are lots of bridges in London.
children.speaker: Daming
children.notes: There are + 复数名词，表示“有很多……”。lots of = 许多。
children.statement: lots of 后面只能接不可数名词。
children.explanation: lots of 既可以修饰可数名词复数，也可以修饰不可数名词。
children.keywords: there are, lots of, bridges, London

children.text: We went to Tower Bridge and had a walk on its glass floor.
children.speaker: Daming
children.cn: 我们去了塔桥，还在它的玻璃地面上走了一圈。
children.notes: went 是 go 的过去式；have a walk = 散步、走走；its 指代塔桥的。
children.statement: its 在句中是代词所有格，指代 Tower Bridge 的。
children.explanation: its 是物主代词“它的”，用来指代 Tower Bridge。

children.text: What a great view!
children.speaker: Daming
children.notes: 省略了主语和谓语的感叹句：What a great view (it is)!
children.statement: 这是一个感叹句。
children.explanation: What a great view! 是感叹句的常用省略形式。

children.text: Fear and Friendly Reassurance
But I was a little scared!
children.speaker: Daming
children.notes: a little = 有点儿，修饰形容词 scared（害怕的）。
children.statement: scared 在句中充当形容词，意为“害怕的”。
children.explanation: scared 是形容词，常与 be 动词连用表示感到害怕。

children.text: I kept thinking about the song and said, "Don't fall down, please!"
children.speaker: Daming
children.cn: 我脑子里总想着那首歌，嘴里念叨：“千万别塌下来，拜托了！”
children.notes: keep doing sth. = 持续/一直做某事；kept 是 keep 的过去式。
children.statement: keep 后面跟动词时通常用不定式 to do 形式。
children.explanation: keep 后面通常跟动名词 v-ing 形式，即 keep doing sth. 表示“一直做某事”。

children.text: Sam laughed and said, "Don't worry. This isn't London Bridge."
children.speaker: Daming
children.cn: 萨姆笑了起来，说道：“别担心，这不是伦敦桥。”
children.notes: Don't worry. = 别担心；Tower Bridge（塔桥）不是童谣中的 London Bridge（伦敦桥）。
children.statement: Don't worry 是表示安慰的常用祈使句否定形式。
children.explanation: Don't worry. 是祈使句的否定式，意思是“别担心”。

children.text: Bobo's Robot Photos & Ending
children.cn: 波波的合成照片与结尾

children.text: We took many photos and Bobo put you in them.
children.speaker: Daming
children.cn: 我们拍了很多照片，波波把你也合成了进去。
children.notes: take photos = 拍照；put you in them = 把你放到照片里。
children.statement: them 在本句中指代的是 photos（照片）。
children.explanation: them 是代词宾格，指代前文提到的 many photos。

children.text: Now you are here with us in London!
children.speaker: Daming
children.cn: 现在你就在伦敦和我们在一起啦！
children.notes: with us = 和我们一起。
children.statement: 这句话表达了朋友间温暖美好的心愿。
children.explanation: 通过合成照片，仿佛玲玲也与大家一同在伦敦游玩。

children.text: Daming
children.speaker: Daming
children.notes: 英文信件结尾的署名。
children.statement: 信末署名写在最后，表示发件人。
children.explanation: 邮件末尾单独写发件人的名字作为署名。

children.text: How beautiful London is! How clever you are!
children.speaker: Lingling
children.cn: 伦敦多漂亮啊！你们真聪明！
children.notes: 感叹句结构：How + 形容词 + 主语 + 谓语！
children.statement: 这两个句子都是由 How 引导的感叹句。
children.explanation: How + adj. + 主 + 谓！用来强烈表达赞美和惊叹。

children.text: Sunday, 19 March: Starting the Journey
Riding Plan in China
Hi there.
children.speaker: John
children.notes: 日记或博文中随和亲近的开场白。
children.statement: Hi there 是一种亲切友好的问候用语。
children.explanation: Hi there 常用于博客、视频或日志中向大家打招呼。

children.text: I'm now in China.
children.speaker: John
children.notes: 现在时态表示当前所处的位置。
children.statement: 句中的 I'm 是 I will 的缩写。
children.explanation: I'm 是 I am 的缩写，表示“我是/我在”。

children.text: I will ride around the country.
children.speaker: John
children.cn: 我打算骑行环游这个国家。
children.notes: will ride = 将要骑行；around the country = 周游全国。
children.statement: will 后面接动词原形表示一般将来时。
children.explanation: 助动词 will 接动词原形表示将来要发生的动作。

children.text: It won't be easy because China is so big!
children.speaker: John
children.cn: 这可不会容易，因为中国太大了！
children.notes: won't = will not；because 引导原因状语从句。
children.statement: because 用来引导结果，而不是原因。
children.explanation: because 是连词，用于引导原因状语从句，意为“因为”。
children.keywords: won't be easy, because, so big

children.text: Seeing China with Own Eyes
It is a beautiful and interesting place.
children.speaker: John
children.cn: 这是一个美丽而有趣的地方。
children.notes: beautiful and interesting 并列形容词作定语。
children.statement: interesting 前面如果有不定冠词，应该用 an。
children.explanation: interesting 以元音音素开头，单独接单数名词前要用 an。

children.text: I just want to see it with my own eyes.
children.speaker: John
children.cn: 我只是想用我自己的双眼去看看它。
children.notes: with one's own eyes = 亲眼；want to do = 想要做某事。
children.statement: with my own eyes 意思是“用我的双眼/亲眼”。
children.explanation: with one's own eyes 是固定短语，表示“亲眼（看到）”。

children.text: Good luck to me!
children.speaker: John
children.notes: Good luck to sb. = 祝某人好运。
children.statement: Good luck 后面常搭配介词 to 来表示对象。
children.explanation: Good luck to... 是常用祝福结构，意为“祝……好运”。

children.text: Sunday, 26 March: Roadside Kindness
children.cn: 3月26日星期日：路边人家的善意

children.text: Lost Bottle and Asking for Help
It's very hot today.
children.speaker: John
children.notes: It 指代天气；hot = 炎热的。
children.statement: 代词 It 可以在句中用来代指天气情况。
children.explanation: 在英语中，it 经常用作无人称代词来指代天气、时间、距离等。

children.text: I lost my water bottle.
children.speaker: John
children.notes: lost 是 lose 的过去式；water bottle = 水壶。
children.statement: lost 是动词 lose 的过去式。
children.explanation: lose（丢失）的一般过去式为不规则变化 lost。

children.text: I went to a house by the road for help.
children.speaker: John
children.cn: 我走到路边的一户人家寻求帮助。
children.notes: by the road = 在路边；for help = 寻求帮助。
children.statement: by the road 在句中表示方位，意为“在路边”。
children.explanation: by 作为介词可以表示“在……旁边”。

children.text: Unexpected Hospitality
I can't speak any Chinese, but they got it!
children.speaker: John
children.cn: 我不会说中文，但他们明白了！
children.notes: can't speak = 不会说；got it = 理解了、懂了；but 表示转折。
children.statement: got it 在口语中表示“明白了；懂了”。
children.explanation: get it 常用作口语表达“明白、领会”，过去式为 got it。

children.text: They gave me some water.
children.speaker: John
children.notes: give sb. sth. = 给某人某物；gave 是 give 的过去式。
children.statement: water 在本句中是不可数名词，用 some 修饰。
children.explanation: water 是物质名词，属于不可数名词，可用 some 修饰。

children.text: To my surprise, they also asked me to stay for lunch.
children.speaker: John
children.cn: 令我惊喜的是，他们还邀请我留下来吃午饭。
children.notes: To one's surprise = 令某人吃惊的是；ask sb. to do sth. = 邀请/要求某人做某事。
children.statement: To my surprise 意为“让我难过的是”。
children.explanation: To my surprise 意为“令我惊讶/吃惊的是”，并非难过。
children.keywords: to my surprise, also, stay for lunch

children.text: The food was so good! I had a special taste of China! How lucky I am!
children.speaker: John
children.cn: 饭菜真是太香了！我品尝到了特别的中国风味！我真幸运啊！
children.notes: taste of = ……的味道/体验；How lucky I am! 感叹句。
children.statement: How lucky I am 是由 How 引导的感叹句。
children.explanation: How + adj. + 主 + 谓！结构，lucky 是形容词。
children.keywords: food, so good, special taste, lucky

children.text: Thursday, 13 April: Water-splashing Festival
Dai New Year Celebration
I'm in Yunnan now.
children.speaker: John
children.notes: Yunnan = 云南省。
children.statement: Yunnan 是专有名词，首字母必须大写。
children.explanation: 地名属于专有名词，首字母大写。

children.text: It's the Water-splashing Festival!
children.speaker: John
children.notes: Water-splashing Festival = 泼水节（傣族传统节日）。
children.statement: Water-splashing Festival 是傣族传统的重要节日泼水节。
children.explanation: Water-splashing Festival 译为泼水节。

children.text: People get together to celebrate the Dai New Year.
children.speaker: John
children.cn: 人们聚在一起庆祝傣历新年。
children.notes: get together = 聚在一起；celebrate = 庆祝；Dai New Year = 傣历新年。
children.statement: 句中的 to celebrate 是动词不定式作目的状语。
children.explanation: to celebrate 表示聚在一起的目的，是不定式作目的状语。
children.keywords: get together, celebrate, Dai New Year

children.text: Splashing Water for Good Luck
They splash water on each other.
children.speaker: John
children.cn: 大家互相把水泼在对方身上。
children.notes: splash water on... = 把水泼在……上；each other = 彼此、互相。
children.statement: each other 意为“互相，彼此”。
children.explanation: each other 是相互代词，表示“互相”。

children.text: To them, this will bring good luck to others.
children.speaker: John
children.cn: 对他们来说，这会给别人带来好运。
children.notes: bring sth. to sb. = 给某人带来某物；good luck = 好运。
children.statement: bring good luck to others 意为“给别人带来好运”。
children.explanation: bring... to... 表示“把……带给……”。

children.text: I get water all over me. How lucky I am!
children.speaker: John
children.cn: 我浑身都湿透了。我真幸运啊！
children.notes: all over me = 全身都是；How lucky I am! 重复感叹呼应主题。
children.statement: all over me 表示“全身都是”。
children.explanation: all over sb. 表示“泼满/洒满浑身”。

children.text: Joy of Exploring New Places
Happy on the Way
On my way to a new place,
children.notes: on one's way to = 在去某处的路上。
children.statement: on my way to 意为“在去往……的路上”。
children.explanation: on one's way to 是固定搭配，表示“在去往某地的途中”。

children.text: I'm always so happy.
children.notes: always 频度副词，意为“总是”。
children.statement: always 是频度副词，放在 be 动词之后。
children.explanation: 频度副词通常置于 be 动词之后、行为动词之前。

children.text: Sights and Differences
So many things are different.
children.cn: 有那么多的事物截然不同。
children.notes: different 是形容词，意为“不同的”。
children.statement: different 的名词形式是 difference。
children.explanation: different 是形容词，difference 是其对应的名词形式。

children.text: Lots of pretty things to see!
children.cn: 好多美妙的事物等待去欣赏！
children.notes: pretty = 漂亮的；lots of = 许多；to see 动词不定式作后置定语。
children.statement: pretty 在句中是形容词，修饰 things。
children.explanation: pretty 作形容词表示“漂亮的、美好的”。
children.keywords: lots of, pretty things, to see

children.text: Facing Problems & Seeking Help
Challenges on the Road
There are many things to learn.
children.cn: 有许许多多事物需要去学习。
children.notes: things to learn = 要学的事物（不定式作定语）。
children.statement: There are 后面接复数名词。
children.explanation: There be 句型遵循就近原则，many things 是复数，所以用 are。

children.text: I have problems here and there.
children.cn: 我在这儿在那儿都会遇到些小麻烦。
children.notes: here and there = 到处、各处；problems = 问题，麻烦。
children.statement: here and there 意为“到处，各处”。
children.explanation: here and there 是固定习语，表示“各处、到处”。

children.text: Polite Request for Assistance
But don't worry - I can say,
children.cn: 但别担心——我可以开口说：
children.notes: But 引导转折；don't worry = 别担心。
children.statement: don't worry 是祈使句的否定式。
children.explanation: don't + 动词原形构成祈使句的否定句。

children.text: "Hello, can you help me, please?"
children.notes: Can you help me, please? 请求帮助的礼貌句型。
children.statement: Can you... please? 是一种礼貌请求对方协助的句型。
children.explanation: 情态动词 can 加上 please 使得求助语气客气礼貌。

tree.text: Penny's Travel Experience in the UK
tree.cn: 佩妮在英国的旅行经历

children.text: A Funny Taxi Experience
The Opening Question
Hey Penny, you travel a lot.
children.speaker: Speaker 1
children.notes: travel a lot = 经常旅行，去很多地方旅行。
children.statement: a lot 在句中作副词修饰动词 travel。
children.explanation: a lot 可修饰动词表示程度或频度高。

children.text: Do you have any funny travel stories?
children.speaker: Speaker 1
children.cn: 你有什么有趣的旅行故事吗？
children.notes: funny = 有趣的，好笑的；stories = story 的复数。
children.statement: 在疑问句中通常用 any 而非 some 修饰名词。
children.explanation: any 一般用于否定句和疑问句中。

children.text: Opening the Front Right Door
Yes, trips are always full of surprises.
children.speaker: Penny
children.cn: 是的，旅途总是充满了惊喜。
children.notes: be full of = 充满……；surprises = 惊喜。
children.statement: be full of 意为“缺乏”。
children.explanation: be full of 意为“充满，装满”，并非缺乏。

children.text: Last year, I went to the UK for the first time.
children.speaker: Penny
children.cn: 去年，我第一次去了英国。
children.notes: for the first time = 第一次；went 是 go 的过去式。
children.statement: for the first time 意为“第一次”。
children.explanation: for the first time 是固定介词短语，表示初次做某事。
children.keywords: last year, went, UK, first time

children.text: I walked up to a taxi and opened the front right door.
children.speaker: Penny
children.cn: 我走向一辆出租车，拉开了右前门。
children.notes: walk up to = 走向……；front right door = 右前门。
children.statement: walked 和 opened 都是动词的一般过去式。
children.explanation: 叙述过去的经历，句中连续使用过去式动词。

children.text: The driver looked at me and laughed.
children.speaker: Penny
children.notes: looked at = 看；laughed = 笑了。
children.statement: looked at 意为“听……”。
children.explanation: look at 意为“看……”，listen to 才是“听……”。

children.text: Cultural Advice & Perspective
Driver's Seat Difference & Advice Query
children.cn: 驾驶座差异与请教建议

children.text: Oh, I see. The driver's seat is on the right in the UK.
children.speaker: Speaker 1
children.cn: 噢，我明白了。在英国驾驶座是在右边的。
children.notes: I see = 我明白了；driver's seat = 驾驶座；on the right = 在右边。
children.statement: 在英国车辆是右舵驾驶，驾驶座在右侧。
children.explanation: 英国采用靠左行驶规则，驾驶座位于车辆右侧。
children.keywords: I see, driver's seat, on the right

children.text: So, what should we do about differences like this?
children.speaker: Speaker 1
children.cn: 那么，面对这样的文化差异我们该怎么做呢？
children.notes: should = 应该（情态动词）；differences like this = 像这样的差异。
children.statement: should 是情态动词，意为“应该”。
children.explanation: should 用于提出建议或征求意见，后接动词原形。

children.text: Penny's Travel Tips
First, learn about the places before you go.
children.speaker: Penny
children.cn: 首先，出发前先了解一下当地的情况。
children.notes: First = 首先；learn about = 了解；before you go = 在你出发之前。
children.statement: before you go 是时间状语从句。
children.explanation: before 引导从句，表示“在……之前”。
children.keywords: first, learn about, before you go

children.text: Be open to differences, and remember it's okay to ask for help.
children.speaker: Penny
children.cn: 对差异保持开放包容的心态，并且记住寻求帮助没关系。
children.notes: be open to = 对……抱开放态度；ask for help = 请求帮助。
children.statement: ask for help 意为“提供帮助”。
children.explanation: ask for help 是“请求/寻求帮助”，offer help 才是“提供帮助”。
children.keywords: be open, differences, ask for help

children.text: Cultural differences can be hard, but they make traveling fun.
children.speaker: Penny
children.cn: 文化差异有时可能让人感到困难，但它们让旅行变得乐趣盎然。
children.notes: make traveling fun = 使旅行变得有趣；can be hard = 可能不容易。
children.statement: 句中 but 表示转折关系。
children.explanation: but 作为并列连词，连接前后转折分句。
